tokens.name: b-25
tokens.usage: Lightest ramp step; a near-white brand wash for fills. Never text or edges.

tokens.name: b-50
tokens.usage: Light brand tint for fills. Never text or edges.

tokens.name: b-100
tokens.usage: Light brand tint for fills and wells. Never text or edges.

tokens.name: b-150
tokens.usage: Tint between b-100 and Soft. Never text or edges.

tokens.name: b-200
tokens.usage: Soft anchor. Rails, chips, hover tints and the focus halo ring. Never text.

tokens.name: b-300
tokens.usage: Tint between Soft and Mid. Decorative only: never text, and too light (under 3:1) for control edges.

tokens.name: b-400
tokens.usage: Mid anchor. Control edges, interactive borders and icons: 5.2:1 on white, 4.5:1 on ground #EEEEEE. Never body text.

tokens.name: b-500
tokens.usage: Step between Mid and b-600, interpolated in Oklab so the ramp keeps even perceptual spacing. 5.3:1 on ground #EEEEEE.

tokens.name: b-600
tokens.usage: Brand text on ground: 6.3:1 on #EEEEEE, 7.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: b-700
tokens.usage: Strong brand text on ground: 8.8:1 on #EEEEEE.

tokens.name: b-800
tokens.usage: Ink anchor. Headings, primary accent, solid button fills (white text on it: 14:1). 12.1:1 on ground.

tokens.name: b-900
tokens.usage: Darker than Ink; for text or fills that must sit below Ink.

tokens.name: b-950
tokens.usage: Deepest brand tone; also the ink tint inside every shadow (rgba(28,12,43,…)).

tokens.name: b-1000
tokens.usage: Darkest ramp step, the near-black brand floor.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand anchor (b-800). Identity only: covers, logos, marketing. UI uses the semantic tokens below so it survives dark mode and brand switching.

tokens.name: mid
tokens.usage: Brand anchor (b-400). Identity only; UI edges use line-control.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Brand anchor (b-200). Identity only; UI tints use accent-soft.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App backdrop behind cards and panels. Dark: b-950.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs: every surface that holds content.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset wells, table header rows, read-only fields, skeletons.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground, surface and surface-2. Light 14.3:1 on ground; dark 15.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field values in dense lists, sub-headings. Light 12.1:1 on ground; dark 13.6:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, meta, timestamps, placeholders on ground, surface and surface-2. Light 6.3:1 on ground; dark 7.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Never for a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Control edges: inputs, secondary buttons, table and chip borders. 4.5:1 on ground #EEEEEE and 5.2:1 on white in light; b-300 in dark for 6.5:1 on every dark surface. Both clear WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected state, active tab indicator, progress fill.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent while hovered: one step darker in light, one step lighter in dark, so the direction of travel always reads as more emphasis.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Light 14.0:1; dark 10.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active tab label, brand-colored text on surface and ground. Light 7.3:1 on surface; dark 9.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, hovered item, active chip background. accent-text on it: light 6.0:1, dark 8.2:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every focusable element, with a soft halo outside it. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Surface lifted above the page: modals, drawers, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Surface pressed below the page: wells, quiet cards, table stripes.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Deepest inset well; matches the app ground so a cut-out reads as a hole.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for surface-inset.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Brand-tinted surface for highlighted rows and selected cards.

tokens.name: app-ground
tokens.usage: The page canvas behind every surface. Alias of ground; both names are live.

tokens.name: b-ground
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for ground.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline: dividers inside a card where structure is already implied.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised structural edge: section boundaries, active rails.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Third text tone, same value as text-muted; kept for legacy rules.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid accent fill. 14:1 in light, 11:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Accent while a control is held down.

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: Accent at conversational weight: links and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Accent wash behind selected rows, hovered nav items and soft badges.

tokens.name: accent-tint-2
tokens.usage: Accent wash one step stronger than accent-tint, for pressed states.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent tone safe for text on the page ground.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus halo behind the 2px focus outline.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for ring.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success state only, always with an icon and a label. 5.5:1 on ground (light), 8.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state only, always with an icon and a label. 5.1:1 on ground (light), 8.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger / error state only, always with an icon and a label. 6.2:1 on ground (light), 7.4:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Success wash behind badges, banners and empty-state art.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for ok-tint.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Success edge, paired with an icon and a word - never colour alone.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Warning wash behind badges and banners.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for warn-tint.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Warning edge, paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger wash behind badges, banners and destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for danger-tint.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Danger edge, paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical data series 1 (violet). Charts, stacked bars and their legend swatches only; never a status. Carries series-on text at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical data series 2 (sky). Charts, stacked bars and their legend swatches only; never a status. Carries series-on text at 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: series-3

tokens.name: series-on

tokens.name: cbi-copper
tokens.usage: The CBI identity copper, the one accent outside the brand ramp and the status hues. Data-import highlights, the unified employee number, and the CBI mark. 7.3:1 on white and 6.3:1 on ground in light, 7.3:1 on surface in dark. It does not follow [data-brand] - that is the point.

styles.usage: Default text, field values, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, button text in compact density.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: IDs, dates, amounts in tables and fields.

fontSize.note: The type scale as raw sizes, for components that cannot take a role class. Never write a font-size that is not one of these.

tokens.name: fs-caption
tokens.usage: Meta, footnotes, table sub-lines, tags. The floor: nothing in the UI is set smaller.

tokens.name: fs-label
tokens.usage: Field labels, buttons, table cells.

tokens.name: fs-control
tokens.usage: Dense controls and secondary headings in cards.

tokens.name: fs-body
tokens.usage: Running text and inputs.

tokens.name: fs-lead
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs, emphasised values.

tokens.name: fs-h3
tokens.usage: Card and section titles.

tokens.name: fs-title
tokens.usage: Panel titles.

tokens.name: fs-h2
tokens.usage: Dialog and page-section titles.

tokens.name: fs-h1
tokens.usage: Page titles.

tokens.name: fs-num-lg
tokens.usage: Big figures in stat tiles.

tokens.name: fs-display
tokens.usage: Hero titles; one per page.

spacing.note: 4pt rhythm expressed in rem, so every gap scales with the font-size preference. Apply with logical properties only (padding-inline, margin-block).

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: 4px, the base step: icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: 8px: small gaps between related items.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: 12px: control padding and row gaps.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: 16px: card and panel padding.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: 20px step of the 4pt rhythm.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: 24px: gaps between sections.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: 32px: gaps between page regions.

tokens.name: s-10
tokens.usage: 40px step of the 4pt rhythm.

tokens.name: s-12
tokens.usage: 48px step of the 4pt rhythm.

tokens.name: s-16
tokens.usage: 64px, the largest step: page-level separation.

radius.note: Radius grows with the size of the surface: badge to modal.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, tags.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: r
tokens.usage: Cards, controls.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Drawers, panels.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, dialogs.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Callouts.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Pill badges, avatars.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for r-lg.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for r.

shadow.note: Tinted with b-950 in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, sticky headers, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Command palette and toasts.

control.note: Density. rem, so controls grow with the font-size preference.

tokens.name: control-h-compact
tokens.usage: 38px at 16px root. Compact density: HR admins working dense tables on desktop.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: 44px at 16px root. Default; also the minimum touch target on phones.

tokens.name: control-h-spacious
tokens.usage: 50px at 16px root. Spacious density: kiosks, touch-first tablets.

breakpoint.note: Container widths. Components respond to their container (container queries), pages to the viewport.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phones: one column, tables become cards, tabs scroll.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: two-column field grids, table visible.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops: side rail appears beside the main column.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops: full sidebar navigation.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens: content max-width stops growing.

layout.note: Shell and navigation sizes. rem, so bars grow with the text-size preference.

tokens.name: nav-w
tokens.usage: 264px. Expanded vertical navigation (SideNav) on laptops and up.

tokens.name: nav-w-rail
tokens.usage: 72px. Collapsed SideNav: icons only, labels as tooltips. Default on tablets.

tokens.name: nav-w-drawer
tokens.usage: 320px, capped at 85% of the screen. SideNav or TopNav links as an off-canvas drawer on phones.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: 64px. TopNav height on tablets and up.

tokens.name: topbar-h-sm
tokens.usage: 56px. Top bar height on phones.

tokens.name: dock-h
tokens.usage: 64px. FloatingNav height, before the device safe-area inset.

tokens.name: card-w
tokens.usage: 416px. The width a record card is drawn at. Fixed-column card grids cap themselves at a whole number of these and centre the remainder, so a full-bleed page never stretches a card past the size it was designed for.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: No cap: page content grows to the full width of the shell. Every page-level container resolves through this one token (.hr-main, .hr-page, the portal container), so a cap can be reintroduced in one place by setting a length such as 90rem. Long-form text is held to a readable measure separately by .hr-measure (68ch), not by this token.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for topbar-h.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for nav-w.

zIndex.note: One stacking scale for the whole app; never invent a z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and section headers.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: In-page dropdowns, lookups and their click-catchers; below the nav and header.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: SideNav, TopNav, FloatingNav.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind a drawer or modal.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Off-canvas navigation and detail drawers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and confirm dialogs.

tokens.name: z-modal-stacked
tokens.usage: A dialog opened from inside another dialog.

tokens.name: z-palette
tokens.usage: The command palette: above any dialog, below toasts.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: Legacy alias for z-nav.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: The sticky top bar, above the rail and below any scrim.

motion.note: Distance-matched durations: a press is not a drawer. Never reuse one duration everywhere.

tokens.name: t-tap
tokens.usage: Pressed and active states.

tokens.name: t-state
tokens.usage: Hover, focus ring, colour changes.

tokens.name: t-move
tokens.usage: Tab shifts, list reordering, layout moves.

tokens.name: t-enter
tokens.usage: Drawer and modal entrance.

tokens.name: t-exit
tokens.usage: Drawer and modal exit: 65% of the entrance, so dismissal feels immediate.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Default curve for state and colour.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Arrival: exponential ease-out for anything entering the screen.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Departure: accelerates away for anything leaving.
